capabilities: Sync WuCai highlights, annotations, page notes and full-text clips into the vault as Markdown
Customize the destination folder, title format and a Nunjucks template for front matter and styling
Run sync manually, on a timer, or automatically when Obsidian opens
Fetch only new and updated notes after the first sync
disambiguation: Not a highlighting tool itself; it only imports highlights already made with the WuCai browser extension.
extras: Sync requires an active WuCai PRO membership (new accounts get a 7-day trial). WuCai has three isolated regions (Asia, Europe, North America) and the configured region must match the account. Further documentation is hosted on the WuCai website in English and Chinese.
problem: Highlights and annotations made with the WuCai browser extension live outside Obsidian; there is no built-in way to pull them into vault notes.
summary: Official WuCai plugin that syncs web highlights, annotations, page notes and full-text clips from WuCai into the vault as Markdown files.
